description.value: Saxe Point Public House is Esquimalt's community-focused neighbourhood pub, serving craft beers from Victoria's local breweries alongside a seasonal menu of fresh, modern takes on pub classics. The pub features a patio, regular live events including trivia and live music, and a warm atmosphere curated by owner Demian Merino, a Victoria hospitality veteran. Cyclists will find a full food and drink menu with vegetarian and gluten-free options in a welcoming spot close to Saxe Point Park.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 21m; rack (1 space) at 28m; rack (3 spaces) at 40m; rack (1 space) at 46m; rack (3 spaces) at 87m; rack (3 spaces) at 94m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and richly detailed, confirming the pub's address (101-505 Park Place Victoria BC) and phone (250.590.5519) match OSM. OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:gluten_free=yes are corroborated by the beer menu listing 'Breakthru Gluten Free Pilsner, IPA, Stout' and the food menu noting vegetarian options. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refills, Wi-Fi, or takeout explicitly.
concerns: Several website subpages use the spelling 'Saxe Pointe Pub' (with a trailing 'e') in the page title, differing slightly from the OSM name 'Saxe Point Public House'; the front page and contact block use 'Saxe Point Pub', consistent with OSM.
Website contact section lists city as 'Victoria BC' while OSM addr:city is 'Esquimalt'; both refer to the same physical location (Esquimalt is a distinct municipality within Greater Victoria).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible pub with a live website, confirmed contact details, and a full food and drink menu — clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through Esquimalt.
